observations.behavior: Adds a new table column and its associated QuotaMeterBar component to display estimated future costs.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users in the Replay Vision product to see projected spending before it occurs, aiding budget management.

observations.behavior: Renders a visual meter for both actual current usage and newly added estimated projections.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides immediate visual feedback on quota consumption against limits, supporting cost control decisions.

observations.behavior: Updates empty state messaging when there are scanners without spend or estimates rather than just those with zero spend.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies user expectations by distinguishing between zero activity and missing data/estimates.

observations.limitations: Changes are confined to frontend presentation; backend ingestion and billing calculations are not shown. No tier-3 systemic benefit is demonstrated.

review.limitations: Changes are confined to frontend presentation; backend ingestion and billing calculations are not shown. No tier-3 systemic benefit is demonstrated.
review.reason: Adds bounded capability and UI correctness within one feature area; no broader system change.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog's managed warehouse and replay vision offerings where customers monitor token and credit quotas.
review.uncertainty: Only frontend implementation visible; cannot assess underlying calculation accuracy or production impact.
